profile.headline: Director of Software Development & Senior Tax Analyst at Agile Consulting Group, Inc.
profile.jobTitle: Director of Software Development / Senior Tax Analyst
profile.summary: I'm a Georgia Gwinnett College graduate and I have a passion for topics related to data analytics, cybersecurity, networking, database administration, and software development.  As an information tech major with a focus on Systems Security, I enjoy working with computers and big data. Plus with a minor in Business Administration, I also love providing leadership and working with people to ensure the maximum value is provided in the end product. With the combination of my major and minor, I have been taught a plethora about computing, databases, businesses, finance, math, programming, and cybersecurity. My experience in leadership roles provided me with the proper know-how on handling complex and dynamic situations while also my experience as a financial coach enabled me to solve problems not only at the difficult major levels but at the minuscule and minor levels as well.

positions.title: Director of Software Development / Senior Tax Analyst
positions.description:
As the Director of Software Development at Agile Consulting Group, I lead the design and delivery of enterprise-grade software solutions that power the firm's operations, compliance & recovery workflows, and manage a great team of data analysts to power such innovation. 

Responsibilities & Accomplishments: 
• Architected and deployed powerful agentic AI workflows that automate complex, multi-step business processes that greatly reduce manual overhead and dramatically improve operational throughput.
• Built and administered Azure cloud infrastructure, including automated pipelines and scalable backend services. 
• Developed and maintained a suite of full-stack and CLI applications supporting record-keeping, data science, operations, and administrative functions using C# with ASP.NET Core and ASP.NET Framework. 
• Designed and optimized SQL databases managing millions of records with a focus on query performance and data integrity. 
• Consult directly with executives on technology strategy, translating business objectives into actionable engineering roadmaps. 

As a senior tax analyst at Agile Consulting Group, my main focus is to also assist in the refund/recovery process by "finding the money" in what we call a reverse audit. 

Responsibilities & Accomplishments:
• Identified and documented $30M+ in sales tax refund opportunities through detailed analysis and reverse audit engagements. 
• Built and maintained strong, trust-based relationships with state and local auditors while navigating complex tax matters with professionalism, responsiveness, and efficiency to accelerate favorable outcomes. 
• Applied in-depth knowledge of sales & use tax laws and regulations accross multiple jurisdictions to uncover exempt purchases where taxes were incorrectly remitted. 
• Prepared comprehensive refund filing packages and audit-ready reports for management and external auditors. 
• Leveraged custom-built software tools to dramatically accelerate the filing process.
positions.insights: Workflow Automation, Sales & Use Tax Compliance and +4 skills

positions.title: Financial Coach
positions.description: As a financial coach, I help consult and provide financial education to clients on both a personal and small business level. I help create financial plans to enable people to become more financially literate, responsible, and independent over time. This includes creating personalized balance sheets and income statements for my clients while also creating a step-by-step guide for them to follow to help them further optimize their finances. Whether my clients are a novice or advanced in financial knowledge, I will also help educate them and ensure they are on the right path. This includes educating them on financial fundamentals such as assets, liabilities, income, and expenses and going to more advanced areas like asset acquisition assistance and consulting.

positions.title: Deli Clerk - Shift Lead
positions.description:
Served customers with energy and smile while also delegating roles and positions with other associates. Ensured customer satisfaction with speed and consistency. Managed shrink and inventory. Ensured proper steps were followed to keep shrink low. Showed leadership and provided a good example for associates to follow.
Summary:
• Provide premier customer service
• Maintain Publix High Standard for freshness and sanitation
• Fill, Maintain, and rotate products displays
• Prepare special orders and party treys
• Operate register, slicer, kitchen fryer, cutting tools and other deli equipment
• Unload truck and stock in designated deli areas weekly
• Lifting items up to 50lbs

positions.title: Front Of House Supervisor
positions.description: Managing front-of-house employees and operations, delegated roles and positions, kept track of company financials to prevent fraud and ensure proper loss prevention techniques are in place. Took care of customers with a big smile, a plethora of energy, and a confident voice.
